docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: OFDM over AWGN
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Independent complete block-OFDM analogue. Missing historical helpers are replaced by an explicit FFT/IFFT and cyclic-prefix contract; pilot placement and the original 48/64 carrier map are not reproduced.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: Frequency-coded communication
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Orthogonal four-FSK complex-baseband analogue. Source text/alphabet conventions, amplitude-coding and plotting exercises are preserved as references, not claimed equivalent.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: Carrier and symbol synchronization
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Explicit Gardner PI timing loop and decision-directed QPSK Costas loop. The five original TED modes, all interpolators and MATLAB System Objects are not reproduced by this smaller contract.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: PFB and WOLA analysis banks
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Two kernel names expose the same defined FIR/DFT analysis-bank transform, with decimation equal to or smaller than the channel count. Source startup indexing and optional FFTW MEX are not reproduced.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: FIR design and filtering
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Hamming-window low-pass design plus complex FIR filtering. The original automatic tap-search and full window family are outside the analogue contract.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: Adaptive filters
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Complex LMS, NLMS and RLS system identification. Outputs include estimates, errors and final coefficients; real source-function comparisons are recorded separately.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: LDPC coding
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Generic systematic GF(2) encoder and SP/MS/NMS/OMS decoders. Portable regression uses an explicit short sparse code; the original (2016,1008) matrix is retained and original-length checks are reported separately.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: Generic noise and interference filters
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Portable notch and scalar Kalman filtering examples. Full OSET biomedical/ARMA models and every selected helper are preserved for reference; these examples do not establish equivalence to all 13 source functions.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: MIMO and diversity
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Complex zero-forcing/MMSE spatial detection and Alamouti combining. Historical large Monte Carlo sweeps, SIC ordering and ISI/ZF demo parameters are not reproduced.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: STFT analysis and reconstruction
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Complex full-spectrum STFT with sqrt-Hann window and normalized overlap-add. Original dual-window and frequency-decimation conventions differ; exact finite-frame reconstruction is tested.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: Speech-preserving spectral gain
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: OM-LSA gain with decision-directed prior SNR and estimated speech presence. Noise is calibrated from a stated noise-only prefix; historical IMCRA noise tracking is not reproduced.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: Array beamforming
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Delay-and-sum complex steering and spatial null test. The 188 book figure/helper files are catalogued together; this analogue does not reproduce every chapter or figure.

docs/typed_model_catalog.json.title: DSP teaching examples
docs/typed_model_catalog.json.limits: Analytic DFT/inverse-DFT and FIR impulse exercises. Other historical examples and Mathcad worksheets remain preserved source material, not separately converted modem models.
